shared_elements: dense repeated small incised marks covering the surface (cuneiform-like signs in A; patterned dotting/hatching of beard, cap and fleece in B)
justification: A is an inscribed panel of ruled lines of wedge-shaped script with no figures at all, while B is a figural relief showing a bearded male in a patterned cap leading two horned rams in profile. The only faint commonality is a taste for dense, regular repeated incised marks covering the surface, which is far too generic to indicate shared iconography.
